description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 14.11.2022 to 20.11.2022
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation.
